MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1172
TRANSFERRING AND CONVEYING TO THE PHILIPPINE TOURISM AUTHORITY CERTAIN
PARCELS OF LAND OF THE PUBLIC AND PRIVATE DOMAIN OF THE GOVERNMENT LOCATED
IN BANAUE, IFUGAO PROVINCE, BAUCO, MT. PROVINCE AND BAGUIO CITY FOR TOURISM
DEVELOPMENT PURPOSES
By virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the
Philippines, hereby transfer and cede to the Philippine Tourism Authority for tourism development purposes
certain parcels of land of the public and private domain of the government located in Banaue, Ifugao, Bauco,
Mt. Province and Baguio City which parcels of land are more particularly described as follows:
"A parcel of land situated in Banaue, Ifugao, beginning at point 1. which is S.20 58'E 868.94 m. from BLLM
1, Banaue,. Ifugao;
thence N. 8035'E., 86.32 m. to pt. 2;
thence S. 16_47'E., 156.57 m. to pt. 3;
thence S. 2_06'E., 159.67 m. to pt. 4;
thence N. 70_34'W., 56.64 m. to pt. 5;
thence N. 42_06'W., 43.16 m. to pt. 6;
thence N. 2_02'W., 250.40 m. to point of beginning containing 28,908 square meters.
"A portion consisting 9.19 hectares of the Mt. Data National Park, located in the Sitio of Halsema Mountain
Road, Sub-Province of Bontoc, Mt. Province, and technically described as follows:
CornersBearingsDistances
corner No. 1 is identical to kilometer post No. 100 Halsema Mountain Road.
III. Baguio City
LinesBearingsDistances
Containing an area of 9,056 square meters, more or less.
Point No. 1 of Lots 1 and 2 is N. 48 08'W. 114.56 M. from triangular station "Happy" Baguio Ts.
All laws, proclamations, executive orders inconsistent herewith are hereby revoked or amended accordingly.
The Philippine tourism Authority may not alienate the said parcels of land or any portion thereof without the
prior approval of the President of the Philippines, although it may encumber the same to any government
financing institution for development purposes.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of July in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-seven.
